failures.reason: Scopes lacked the shared RTSs reached by branches (6FB4 from 6FB6's BPL; 7B56 from 7B58's BNE); the CAF0 callback stop needed its own stack depth (EFFC); 9288 is also the {7, 1} effect, entered by JSR (A2), one level deeper than 7ED2's BRA; 5964 writes the door's +0E; the sparkle check missed presentation bytes and printed slots from 24-bit addresses; '0x312e+2' lexed as one preprocessing number; one out-of-scope read was the harness's own post-run check; the reference door line omitted +4A.
complete_spell tested FF33E2 before 6F02's two allocations; the original allocates first, so an exhausted stack must win. Reordered.

P1's evidence failed with 'transition block changed outside 1345A': on 1433 and 1447 the trace's events after P1's wrapper (the object loop) see the world's 13294/1324E write; they are no longer P1 evidence on those frames. Then 'timer phase differs': 1345A's positive-direction level steps return through 134D4, unknown to the session validator, which now traces and accepts it (the session regressions were recaptured fresh). Offline on the artifacts the native timer print differed at 1433 (it showed the timer after the world's 13294); P1SessionResult::transition now carries the timer as 1345A left it. All 881 frames then matched offline and the joined capture was rerun fresh.
